description: This Java abstract class defines methods for managing database schema creation and index setup for the Thingsboard platform, including executing SQL scripts from files and handling database connections.

classes.name: SqlAbstractDatabaseSchemaService
classes.description: Abstract class providing database schema creation and index management functionalities for Thingsboard.

methods.name: createDatabaseSchema
methods.description: Creates the database schema, optionally including indexes.

methods.name: createDatabaseSchema
methods.description: Creates the database schema with an option to include indexes.

methods.name: createDatabaseIndexes
methods.description: Creates database indexes if schema index SQL is provided.

methods.name: executeQueryFromFile
methods.description: Reads SQL from a file and executes it on the database.

methods.name: executeQuery
methods.description: Executes a SQL query on the database.

methods.name: executeQuery
methods.description: Executes a SQL query with optional logging.
